channel.title: AI Frontier Post
channel.description: Dispatches from the AI frontier: AI news, research explainers, frontier lab coverage, and product comparisons.

item.title: Fable 5.2 built a swimmable underwater world in a single 97 KB HTML file — and Reddit is diving in
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: A Reddit user turned one Claude Code prompt into Abyssal Garden — a swimmable, fully procedural underwater world that ships as a single 96.8 KB HTML file. It took off on r/ClaudeAI within hours.

item.title: LoopForge Local: Turn Claude Code Into a Staged Delivery Pipeline
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Tencent’s LoopForge hit GitHub trending this week. Its Local edition installs a staged, human-gated delivery workflow into Claude Code with one npx command — no server, no Docker. Every step verified.

item.title: Google’s Gemini glasses are real: pre-orders open at $395, in stores December 10
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Google and Samsung opened pre-orders for Gemini-powered Intelligent Eyewear on November 12 — Warby Parker frames from $395, Gentle Monster from $449 — with a December 10 launch in the US and South Korea, and a privacy pitch aimed at the bystanders as much as the wearers.

item.title: Put your agent in a real UI: hands-on with AG-UI, the protocol that connects agents to frontends
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: AG-UI is the open protocol that turns any agent into a streaming, tool-calling, state-sharing UI — the missing third leg next to MCP and A2A. Build a working server in Python, drive it from TypeScript, and add a real tool call. Every command verified, no API key needed for the core loop.

item.title: Build a streaming AI chat app with the Vercel AI SDK and a local Ollama model — no API key needed
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: A complete streaming chatbot — Next.js, AI SDK 7, and a local Ollama model — with a working tool call and zero API keys. Every command verified end to end.

item.title: Edge0-145B: a 145-billion-parameter open model that runs on a laptop at 80 tokens a second
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Edge0 has open-sourced Edge0-145B, a 145-billion-parameter model it says runs on a 48GB laptop at more than 80 tokens a second — with benchmark scores that, on the company's own tests, rival frontier cloud models. Every headline number is the vendor's own, and none has been independently verified yet.

item.title: Run your own daily AI stock briefing: hands-on with Daily Stock Analysis
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Daily Stock Analysis turns a watchlist into a scored morning briefing — quotes, technicals, news sentiment, and risk flags, written by a language model you choose. Follow the full setup, verified end to end, from pip install to your first scheduled run.

item.title: Google plugs Gemini into your Wallet: spending insights, subscription audits, and a read-only promise
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: Google has connected Google Wallet to Gemini’s Personal Intelligence, letting the assistant answer personal-finance questions from your real spending — read-only, opt-in, and US-only for now. It lands the same day OpenAI gave its own agents a wallet, but the two products point in opposite directions.

item.title: Anthropic's Claude Code Projects get a proactive coordinator, thread sharing and reminders
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: Anthropic announced a batch of upgrades to Projects in Claude Code on November 13: the coordinator now answers questions and posts status updates in the project chat, /btw and /fork split work into side threads, and individual threads can be shared as read-only links. The announcement passed 525,000 views overnight.

item.title: AgentRun: Self-Improving Managed Agents You Can Run Yourself — Hands-On
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: AgentRun puts a control plane around the coding agent you already run — self-improvement, durable runs, approvals and spend caps. I installed 0.4.2, verified every command in this tutorial, and ran the platform end to end except the live agent run, which needs a model key.

item.title: Amodei's 'AI will solve biology' clip goes viral — and the drug industry pushes back hard
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: A 77-second clip of Anthropic's CEO arguing that AI will crack biology “little by little, then all at once” hit the top of r/accelerate on Friday. It landed in the middle of a much bigger fight: his IPO-week claim that cancer, Alzheimer's and heart disease will be “relics of the past” within a decade — and a wave of doctors, drug developers and Eli Lilly's CEO saying the timeline is impossible.

item.title: LangChain raises $300M at a $3B valuation to turn LangSmith into the operating system for agents
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: LangChain raised $300 million at a $3 billion valuation, led by CapitalG, to build out LangSmith — its platform for running, improving, and governing AI agents in production. The round more than doubles the company’s value in about a year.

item.title: WSJ: Huang clashed with Kress over Nvidia's circular financing as prepaid chips piled up 'like an avalanche'
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: The Wall Street Journal reports that before his resignation, Jensen Huang berated CFO Colette Kress over Nvidia's program of financing its own chip buyers — underwriting demand to absorb an ‘avalanche’ of prepaid silicon. Reddit’s LocalLLaMA crowd is split between ‘just business’ and ‘Enron 2.0.’

item.title: Stop re-explaining your codebase: set up Gentle-AI so your coding agent remembers, plans, and proves its work
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Gentle-AI configures the coding agent you already use — persistent memory, a deterministic workflow, and a review state machine that refuses to guess. I installed v4.5.0, verified every command in this tutorial, and measured exactly where it stops and your agent takes over.

item.title: AMD launches the Instinct MI450X and claims 30% faster inference than Nvidia’s Vera Rubin
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: AMD’s new MI450X packs 288GB of HBM4 into its Helios rack, and the company says its bigger MI455X sibling beats Nvidia’s Vera Rubin by up to 30% on DeepSeek-R1 — measured in AMD’s own labs.

item.title: “The next generation will never see a real video”: the viral AI pitch Reddit can’t agree is real
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: A 49-second clip claims to be 100% AI — swappable presenters, matched voices, products that were never in the room. It passed 750 upvotes in hours, and the top comments are doing frame-by-frame forensics on whether any of it is true.

item.title: The FAA’s $875M AI air-traffic tool went nationwide — then every US flight was grounded
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: The FAA’s new AI route-planning tool, SMART, reached all 22 air traffic centers this week. Hours later, a communications failure grounded every departing flight in America — and the internet blamed the AI. The evidence says otherwise.

item.title: Cut 90 ms off every voice-assistant turn: hands-on with RealtimeVAD
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: RealtimeVAD spots the end of your sentence about 90 ms before Silero VAD does — by watching the audio go quiet instead of waiting for a probability to fall. It installs with one pip command, needs no GPU and no API key, and I measured its lead on real speech before writing a word of this tutorial.

item.title: Build a fast agentic coding loop with Gemini 4 Hydrogen
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: Google's fast execution model costs $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens, thinks at four levels, and has a free tier. This tutorial builds a complete coding agent on its function-calling API — verified call by call against the Python SDK — and prices every run to the cent.

item.title: OpenAI folds its robotics team into core research, betting general models can run robots
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: OpenAI has dissolved its stand-alone robotics team for the second time in six years, moving its researchers into the main research group and its hardware staff into Applied — a bet that general-purpose models like GPT-6 Astra can now run robots without a specialist team in between.

item.title: Log every LLM call: run llmtee, the self-hosted proxy that shows what your AI really costs
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: llmtee is a single Go binary that sits between your apps and your LLM provider, logging every request with tokens, cost, latency and time to first token — plus hard per-key budgets. Here's how to run it in ten minutes.

item.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT Wallet, letting its dots agents pay without ever seeing your card
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: OpenAI’s dots agents can now complete a purchase for you. ChatGPT Wallet swaps your real card for a single-use token — and every order still needs your face or fingerprint to go through.

item.title: Build your own AI app on llama.cpp 1.0: the stable C API, hands-on
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: llama.cpp 1.0 freezes the C API after three and a half years of nightly builds. Build it from source and write a real chat program against libllama — load, tokenize, template, decode, sample — with every number measured on a CPU-only machine.

item.title: World Labs opens Atlas to everyone: build a 3D world from a photo, then export it as splats or meshes
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: World Labs opened its Atlas world model to everyone on November 12, with two web apps — Viewfinder and Chisel — and a public API that turn photos, generated images, or blocked-out geometry into explorable 3D worlds.

item.title: Claude Trading Skills: Turn Claude Code Into a Disciplined Investing Workflow
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: Claude Trading Skills packs 74 investing skills into Claude Code — market-regime checks, position sizing, and a trade journal that runs on free public data. I installed it and ran the full 15-minute daily check; here is exactly how it works.
